1|# IVX Android Release APK Build + Emulator QA
     2|#
     3|# Builds a RELEASE APK (with JS bundle + assets) using the committed
     4|# expo/android/ directory, then installs it on an emulator and runs Maestro QA.
     5|#
     6|# Proven path mirrors ivx-ci.yml android-apk job:
     7|#   - bun install at root + expo
     8|#   - NO expo prebuild --clean (uses committed android/ directory)
     9|#   - assembleRelease
    10|#   - explicit JAVA_HOME / ANDROID_HOME
    11|#
    12|# Triggers:
    13|#   - Push to main (when chat files, Maestro flows, or this workflow change)
    14|#   - Manual dispatch via GitHub Actions UI
    15|
    16|name: Android Emulator QA
    17|
    18|on:
    19|  push:
    20|    branches: [main]
    21|    paths:
    22|      - 'expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx'
    23|      - 'expo/src/modules/chat/**'
    24|      - 'expo/.maestro/**'
    25|      - 'expo/eas.json'
    26|      - 'expo/app.config.ts'
    27|      - 'expo/package.json'
    28|      - 'expo/assets/images/**'
    29|      - 'expo/plugins/**'
    30|      - '.github/workflows/android-emulator-qa.yml'
    31|  workflow_dispatch:
    32|    inputs:
    33|      run_full_qa:
    34|        description: 'Run full chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)'
    35|        required: false
    36|        default: false
    37|        type: boolean
    38|
    39|env:
    40|  EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com
    41|  NODE_ENV: production
    42|  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
    43|  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
    44|  EXPO_PUBLIC_QA_BUILD: 'true'
    45|  OWNER_EMAIL: iperez4242@gmail.com
    46|
    47|permissions:
    48|  contents: read
    49|  issues: write
    50|
    51|jobs:
    52|  build-and-test:
    53|    name: Android Release APK Build + Emulator QA
    54|    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    55|    timeout-minutes: 60
    56|    outputs:
    57|      build_status: ${{ steps.build.outputs.build_status }}
    58|      apk_path: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}
    59|      apk_hash: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.hash }}
    60|      apk_size: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.size }}
    61|      emulator_name: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.name }}
    62|      android_version: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.version }}
    63|      emulator_status: ${{ steps.emu.outcome }}
    64|
    65|    steps:
    66|      - name: Checkout code
    67|        uses: actions/checkout@v4
    68|        with:
    69|          fetch-depth: 1
    70|
    71|      - name: Setup Bun
    72|        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
    73|        with:
    74|          bun-version: 1.3.9
    75|
    76|      - name: Setup Java 17
    77|        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
    78|        with:
    79|          distribution: 'temurin'
    80|          java-version: '17'
    81|
    82|      - name: Setup Android SDK
    83|        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
    84|        with:
    85|          packages: 'platform-tools platforms;android-36 build-tools;36.0.0 ndk;27.1.12297006 cmake;3.22.1'
    86|          log-accepted-android-sdk-licenses: false
    87|
    88|      - name: Install root dependencies
    89|        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
    90|
    91|      - name: Install Expo dependencies
    92|        working-directory: expo
    93|        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
    94|
    95|      - name: Verify tooling
    96|        working-directory: expo
    97|        run: |
    98|          echo "=== Tool versions ==="
    99|          bun --version
   100|          node --version
   101|          npx expo --version
   102|
   103|      - name: Prepare QA signing key
   104|        run: |
   105|          set -euo pipefail
   106|          QA_KEYSTORE="$HOME/.android/debug.keystore"
   107|          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$QA_KEYSTORE")"
   108|          # Recreate the CI-only signer on every run so a runner image's stale or
   109|          # malformed debug keystore can never be selected for the release candidate.
   110|          rm -f "$QA_KEYSTORE"
   111|          keytool -genkeypair -v \
   112|            -keystore "$QA_KEYSTORE" \
   113|            -storepass android \
   114|            -alias androiddebugkey \
   115|            -keypass android \
   116|            -keyalg RSA \
   117|            -keysize 2048 \
   118|            -validity 10000 \
   119|            -dname "CN=IVX CI QA, OU=Engineering, O=IVX Holdings, L=Miami, ST=Florida, C=US"
   120|          keytool -list -keystore "$QA_KEYSTORE" -storepass android -alias androiddebugkey >/dev/null
   121|          echo "QA signing key verified. This signer is for QA artifacts only."
   122|
   123|      # ============================================================
   124|      # Build a disposable QA APK. Production release signing is isolated from
   125|      # this workflow and never uses this runner-generated debug signer.
   126|      # ============================================================
   127|      - name: Build Android QA APK
   128|        id: build
   129|        working-directory: expo/android
   130|        timeout-minutes: 30
   131|        env:
   132|          JAVA_HOME: ${{ env.JAVA_HOME }}
   133|          ANDROID_HOME: ${{ env.ANDROID_SDK_ROOT }}
   134|          IVX_QA_KEYSTORE: ${{ runner.home }}/.android/debug.keystore
   135|        run: |
   136|          set -o pipefail
   137|          echo "=== Building disposable QA APK with Gradle ==="
   138|          echo "JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME"
   139|          echo "ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME"
   140|          chmod +x gradlew
   141|          ./gradlew assembleQa --no-daemon -x lint 2>&1 | tee gradle-build.log
   142|          GRADLE_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
   143|          echo "=== Gradle exit code: $GRADLE_EXIT ==="
   144|          echo "build_exit=$GRADLE_EXIT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   145|          if [ "$GRADLE_EXIT" -eq 0 ]; then
   146|            echo "build_status=success" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   147|          else
   148|            echo "build_status=failed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   149|            echo "=== BUILD FAILED — last 400 lines ==="
   150|            tail -400 gradle-build.log
   151|            echo "### Build Failure — Last 400 Lines" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   152|            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   153|            tail -400 gradle-build.log >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   154|            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
   155|            exit 1
   156|          fi
   157|
   158|      # ALWAYS run — uploads the full Gradle log even when the build fails.
   159|      - name: Upload Gradle build log
   160|        if: always()
   161|        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
   162|        with:
   163|          name: ivx-android-qa-gradle-log-${{ github.sha }}
   164|          path: expo/android/gradle-build.log
   165|          retention-days: 30
   166|
   167|      # Create a diagnostic GitHub issue if the build failed.
   168|      - name: Create diagnostic issue on build failure
   169|        if: always() && steps.build.outcome != 'success'
   170|        working-directory: expo/android
   171|        env:
   172|          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
   173|        run: |
   174|          echo "::error::Gradle QA build failed. Creating diagnostic issue with error logs."
   175|          {
   176|            echo "## Android QA APK Build Diagnostics"
   177|            echo ""
   178|            echo "**Commit:** ${GITHUB_SHA}"
   179|            echo "**Run:** ${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
   180|            echo "**Build step outcome:** ${{ steps.build.outcome }}"
   181|            echo ""
   182|            echo "### Gradle build output (last 800 lines)"
   183|            echo '```'
   184|            tail -800 gradle-build.log 2>/dev/null || echo "gradle-build.log not found"
   185|            echo '```'
   186|          } > diagnostic-body.md
   187|          # Create issue via GitHub API (gh CLI sometimes fails silently in this runner)
   188|          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST \
   189|            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ github.token }}" \
   190|            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   191|            -d "$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'title':'Android QA APK Build Diagnostics — ${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}','body':open('diagnostic-body.md').read(),'labels':['android-qa-diagnostic']}))")" \
   192|            "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues")
   193|          echo "Issue create response: $RESPONSE"
   194|          echo "$RESPONSE" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Created issue:', d.get('html_url', d.get('message','unknown')))"
   195|
   196|      - name: Find built APK
   197|        id: apk
   198|        working-directory: expo/android
   199|        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
   200|        run: |
   201|          echo "=== Searching for QA APK ==="
   202|          APK_PATH=$(find app/build/outputs/apk/qa -name "*.apk" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1)
   203|          if [ -z "$APK_PATH" ]; then
   204|            echo "::error::No QA APK found"
   205|            find . -name "*.apk" 2>/dev/null
   206|            exit 1
   207|          fi
   208|          APK_PATH_ABS="$(cd "$(dirname "$APK_PATH")" && pwd)/$(basename "$APK_PATH")"
   209|          echo "path=$APK_PATH_ABS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   210|          echo "APK found: $APK_PATH_ABS"
   211|          ls -lh "$APK_PATH_ABS"
   212|          APK_HASH=$(sha256sum "$APK_PATH_ABS" | awk '{print $1}')
   213|          echo "hash=$APK_HASH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   214|          echo "APK SHA256: $APK_HASH"
   215|          APK_SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$APK_PATH_ABS" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$APK_PATH_ABS" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
   216|          echo "size=$APK_SIZE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
   217|          echo "APK size: $APK_SIZE bytes"
   218|
   219|      - name: Upload APK artifact
   220|        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
   221|        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
   222|        with:
   223|          name: ivx-android-qa-apk-${{ github.sha }}
   224|          path: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}
   225|          retention-days: 30
   226|          if-no-files-found: error
   227|
   228|      - name: Boot Emulator + Install APK + Launch + QA
   229|        id: emu
   230|        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
   231|        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
   232|        with:
   233|          api-level: 34
   234|          arch: x86_64
   235|          profile: pixel_7
   236|          target: google_apis
   237|          disable-animations: true
   238|          emulator-options: -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-snapshot -noaudio -no-boot-anim
   239|          script: |
   240|            echo "=== Emulator booted ==="
